auto_accept_note: ARMED by Bob's explicit call (2026-08-13). INERT until the IdP is live — nothing consumes this config yet, so it admits NOBODY today. When the enclave/OIDC (N1) is stood up, true here auto-admits EVERY registrant at read-only. capability_note: member = read + propose. Reading is open once admitted; CREATING anything is a proposal the Yes-Gate holds for Bob or Ken. A member never creates without approval.
rate_limit_note: At most one auto-onboarding per minute; the rest queue. Abuse throttle for open registration.

drip.cadence: welcome on admission, one email/day for days 1-14, then weekly
drip.feedback_note: every email ends with a feedback footer naming Ken and Bob with both addresses

brain_note: Keep all this traffic in the brain: every send emits a metadata-only ledger receipt (template id + recipient hash + timestamp) — never the body, never PII. The brain is the signed ledger.

monitoring.note: Every member effect is a proposal receipt; stewards see all, members see only their own. No new machinery — this is the governed core.
